title: Illinois Secretary of State Alexi Giannoulias announces campaign for Chicago mayor

statements.summary: Calls for construction of housing that working Chicagoans can afford.
statements.quote: He called for policies such as universal pre-K for Chicago's children, raising the minimum wage, and construction of housing that working Chicagoans can afford.

statements.summary: States Chicago should never become a city reserved only for the wealthy.
statements.quote: "Chicago should never become a city reserved only for the wealthy," he said.
